title: Battle of Gitschin
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Gitschin", at revision 1370441663, opens: "The Battle of Gitschin or Jičín took place during the Austro-Prussian War on 29 June 1866, ending with a Prussian victory over the Austrian forces. There is a memorial there today at Jičín in the Czech Republic." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q574365, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
